notes.title: v2.333 2.5 Update
notes.content:
Added Italian language support.
 Optimized localization translations for French and Turkish.
 Introduced a feature that adjusts in-game video content based on device performance, aiming to resolve issues with video playback on certain devices.
 Fixed the issue where the BGM disappeared after Fleeting Memories finished playing.

notes.title: The NOexistenceN of you AND me now supports Russian, Brazilian, and Indonesian!
notes.content:
Hello! We are very excited to announce that 《The NOexistenceN of you AND me》 now supports localization in Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, and Indonesian!

These language versions were passionately contributed by community players, whose support and efforts have allowed Lilith's story to reach even more people. We extend our heartfelt thanks to all the contributors~

In addition, some localization work is still ongoing:

Voice Acting:   Portuguese (Brazil) 

Languages:   Turkish  Spanish (Latin America)  Ukrainian 

Also, there's one more thing!

Do you remember the great adventure with Lilith in the Silver Onion Forest—meeting scholars, fighting side by side, and finally defeating the Demon King…

But that was just a demo…

A game without a complete world setting, without more characters, without battles and skills, without map exploration, without rich side quests and adventure stories, and without free decisions.

That’s not even really a demo!! (Sorry, Lilith)

But the good news is—We are actively developing the second part of the 《The NOexistenceN》 series. This time, Lilith will take you on an even more exciting and complete adventure!

Stay tuned~

notes.title: v2.333 1.5 Update
notes.content:
Added the ability to skip concert videos, credits, and the staff list after completing any ending.  
 Fixed an issue where Lilith's sprite position would appear incorrect under certain conditions.  
 Fixed an issue where the default text printing speed was incorrect when running the game in an English language environment under certain conditions.  
 Fixed incorrect information display on the "My Settings" interface.  
 Fixed an issue where some text in the history log extended beyond the game window.  
 Fixed the unclear game software icon issue.

notes.title: v2.333 1.4 Update
notes.content:
New Art Collection System: When you complete a chapter, related CGs, character illustrations, or videos will be added to the "Fleeting Memories" collection.
 Fixed the issue where the game could not proceed due to corrupted save files: If your save file is corrupted and prevents you from continuing, your save data and game progress will be reset.
